outcome.summary: The call ended early after a brief language switch from Tamil to English. No screening questions were completed as the candidate asked the recruiter to continue the details.
outcome.recruiter_notes: Candidate requested to switch to English and wanted information put directly, but the call dropped before screening could begin.

transcript.text: Hello, this is suguna from Zenbyte. Am I speaking with sugi?

Got it, we’ll chat in Tamil. 

அப்படியே, நாங்கள் முன் பேசினபோது, உங்களுக்கு நேர்முகத்தில் ரியல்‑டைம் வழிகாட்டல், PDF‑ல் சுருக்கமான பதில்கள், மற்றும் மொக்‑இன்டர்வியூ வழங்குவோம். இது உங்களுக்கு பயனுள்ளதாக இருக்கும் என்று நினைக்கிறீர்களா?
You can continue in English itself. Tell me and put it here. Put it here.
Sure, we provide real‑time prompts and a concise PDF with suggested answers that you can glance at during the interview. I can share the PDF link on WhatsApp right now—does that work?
